title: LeanCTX allowlist blocked owlspec inside Projects
close_reason: Fixed in 70006e8: the dev shell extends the LeanCTX allowlist through the never-trust-gated data-dir config, verified from an untrusted Project directory after wiping local state.

title: Decide the first commit and remote for the aerie workspace repository
description: bd init created the git repository and an initial commit that mixed beads setup with its own agent-config writes. That commit was removed, so the repository now has zero commits with every file staged. A human should decide the first commit and whether a remote is added.
close_reason: Initial commit abce342 created with the whole harness. Adding a remote is deliberately left out: it is outward-facing and needs the repository home.

title: Remove bd-installed Claude hooks from .claude/settings.json
description: bd init registered SessionStart and PreCompact hooks running bd prime, plus it wrote AGENTS.md and created CLAUDE.md. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are restored and the harness now mandates bd init --skip-agents, but the two hook blocks remain in .claude/settings.json and apm audit reports the file as drifted. Editing that file is blocked by the agent permission classifier, so a human must delete the SessionStart and PreCompact entries and leave the APM PreToolUse hook.
close_reason: Removed the SessionStart and PreCompact bd prime hooks; APM re-synced the file to its canonical form and apm audit now reports no drift.

title: Integrate Owlspec as the harness Truth layer
description: Owlspec 0.2.0 released. Add the owlspec binary to the Nix dev shell, pin the owlspec skill through APM, rewrite the Owlspec rules in the APM instruction and Skill sources, and keep canonical output out of LeanCTX compression.
close_reason: Owlspec 0.2.0 wired into the Nix dev shell, pinned as an APM skill dependency, and made the Truth layer in the APM instruction and Skill sources. LeanCTX now allows owlspec and preserves its output verbatim. Verified end to end in a throwaway project.

title: Add a git remote for the aerie workspace and push
description: The repository has one local commit and no remote. Adding one is a human decision because it needs the repository home and publishes the harness.

title: Document lean-ctx trust as a per-clone setup step
description: LeanCTX withholds security-sensitive .lean-ctx.toml keys until an operator runs lean-ctx trust in the Workspace root, and trust is pinned to the file contents so it must be re-run after every edit. shell_allowlist_extra and rules_injection both depend on it, so a fresh clone silently runs without them until trusted.
close_reason: Documented in README.md as a bootstrap step with the reason it is easy to miss, and added an agent-facing rule to report an untrusted workspace instead of proceeding.

title: Decide how the harness handles x86_64-darwin without Owlspec
description: Owlspec publishes builds for x86_64-linux, aarch64-linux and aarch64-darwin only. flake.nix still lists x86_64-darwin, where evaluating the dev shell now throws a message naming the gap. Either drop that system from the flake or ask upstream for an Intel macOS build.
close_reason: Dropped x86_64-darwin from the flake systems. The harness requires its Truth layer and Owlspec publishes no Intel-macOS build, so an incomplete harness is not offered. The asset lookup still throws if a system is added without its asset.
